positiveAssertions: Assert exact version, portable path ID, resolved path, executable SHA-256, and merged toolchain lock identity for JDK, Scala CLI, Scala, Scalafmt, and Scalafix.
negativeAssertions: Any version, path, SHA, vendor, runtime, or lock mismatch exits nonzero before compilation.
smokes.provenFallback: No toolchain substitution is allowed; report the exact missing or mismatched prerequisite.

positiveAssertions: Compile a clean source independently with every frozen stable compiler flag on Scala 3.8.4 and JDK 25.
negativeAssertions: Each predeclared warning fixture must fail under -Werror and the intended warning flag.
smokes.provenFallback: Remove no stable hard flag; a frozen-profile incompatibility is BLOCKED_TOOLCHAIN.

positiveAssertions: Use the exact nested .scalafmt.conf and Scalafmt 3.11.4 for real-source parse, format, second-pass byte idempotence, and non-mutating check.
negativeAssertions: Misformatted source fails check and any unintended or generated formatter config fails source-input equality.
artifacts: first and second pass source-tree SHA-256
smokes.provenFallback: No silent downgrade or formatter replacement is allowed.

positiveAssertions: Standalone Scalafix 0.14.7 DisableSyntax accepts clean production source.
negativeAssertions: Each forbidden syntax fixture fails, including null, return, casts, type tests, and throw.
smokes.provenFallback: No Scala CLI experimental fix integration is substituted for the standalone runner.

positiveAssertions: Parser and semantic or typed-AST policy gates accept a clean fixture with exact empty mutation, partial, suppression, and JMH override ledgers.
negativeAssertions: Reject implicit conversions, runtimeChecked, experimental imports, partial APIs, exception APIs, unauthorized mutation, qualified aliases, renamed or wildcard imports, receiver-type evasion, plan-overriding JMH annotations, and stale allowlists.
smokes.provenFallback: Use conservative alias-aware typed-tree or AST fallback and fail closed when a symbol cannot be resolved.

positiveAssertions: Exact Scala 3.8.4 SemanticDB and classpath run ExplicitResultTypes over public boundaries.
negativeAssertions: A public boundary lacking an explicit result type is rejected when semantic mode is qualified.
smokes.provenFallback: Require explicit source annotations plus compiler and public-boundary audit while retaining every syntactic hard gate.

positiveAssertions: Compile and list a minimal JMH benchmark, select exactly one case, run it, and validate native JSON mode, unit, value, effective JVM arguments, and case identity.
negativeAssertions: Unexpected case selection, plan-overriding annotation or CLI JVM argument, missing effective argument evidence, non-finite value, or wrong mode and unit fails.
smokes.provenFallback: Repair only the pinned Scala CLI JMH harness; an alternate benchmark framework requires a new contract.

positiveAssertions: Profiles A, B, and C each pass the mini fixture full correctness matrix with exact artifact and options hashes.
negativeAssertions: Any mismatch, optimizer warning, source drift, dependency-wide inline scope, or artifact/options mismatch rejects that optimized profile.
smokes.provenFallback: Use Profile A when no optimized profile qualifies.

positiveAssertions: Assert exact authoritative GHC, Stack, LTS, HLint, stylish-haskell, GHCup whereis path, installed binary SHA, numeric versions, and structured Stack provenance.
negativeAssertions: Any path, SHA, version, metadata, archive, installed-binary role, or provenance-lock mismatch exits nonzero.
smokes.provenFallback: No toolchain substitution or automatic installation is allowed.

positiveAssertions: Generated Cabal uses GHC2024, hard warnings, mandatory Safe for safe-scalar, NoFFI/NoTH/NoCPP/NoGND/NoDerivingVia/NoDeriveAnyClass for every core, and deriving stock.
negativeAssertions: Data.Vector.Unboxed under -XSafe is rejected; audited-pure-vector rejects IO, unsafe or foreign direct imports, core-to-shell edges, and candidate Trustworthy or Unsafe declarations.
smokes.provenFallback: Keep vector kernels audited-pure-vector and scalar-only trusted modules safe-scalar; never claim a Trustworthy wrapper.

positiveAssertions: Exact stylish-haskell performs a non-mutating full-source check and exact HLint accepts clean source.
negativeAssertions: Misformatting and qualified or aliased partial and unsafe functions fail without source-local ignore or auto-rewrite.
smokes.provenFallback: Only a typed central exception with focused totality test may handle an approved false positive.

positiveAssertions: Run a minimal Tasty suite and Criterion build, list, exact-one-case execution, native JSON schema validation, and finite positive timing validation.
negativeAssertions: Unexpected selection, wrong mode, missing case, invalid unit, lazy unevaluated output, or invalid native JSON fails.
smokes.provenFallback: Repair only the pinned Tasty and Criterion harness.

positiveAssertions: Authoritative baseline -O0 -fasm and optimized -O2 -fasm each pass mini full correctness with exact artifact and options hashes.
negativeAssertions: Any mismatch, forbidden flag, source drift, or artifact/options mismatch rejects the optimized profile.
smokes.provenFallback: Use baseline-o0-fasm when optimized-o2-fasm does not qualify.

positiveAssertions: Attempt the GHC 9.14.1 non-scoring dependency build with identical non-boot sources, versions, and flags; if solve succeeds, run minimal correctness and process replay.
negativeAssertions: Classify frozen dependency failure separately from candidate source, environment, and unclassified failure with a minimal reproducer and exact downstream closure.
smokes.provenFallback: A narrowly proven FAIL_FROZEN_DEPENDENCY is non-scoring; every other failure remains a blocker according to the frozen policy.
